title: Basis of the Monthly Invoice on an Office Pantry & Beverage Program Agreement
content:
Each billing period the programme is invoiced the monthly programme fee printed against the tier in force, plus the per-head charge printed against the same tier applied to the headcount the client reports for that period. This note states the basis of that invoice on an Office Pantry & Beverage Program agreement.

## How the invoiced amount stands

The per-head charge for the period is the monthly per-head figure printed against the tier in force multiplied by the badged headcount the client reports for that period, rounded to two decimal places. The amount invoiced is the monthly programme fee printed against that same tier plus that per-head charge, rounded to two decimal places.

Worked on hypothetical figures: a hypothetical monthly programme fee of 500.00, a hypothetical per-head figure of 8.00 and a reported headcount of 46 badged employees. The per-head charge is 368.00, and the amount invoiced is 868.00.

## When the invoice is raised, and what stands in the fee's place

The programme fee is only invoiced while the programme stands active or paused; a paused programme is invoiced the standby charge printed against its tier in place of the programme fee, and no per-head charge is raised for the paused months. The status standing on the programme is read from Larkspur Table's own record of that programme, together with the headcount recorded against it, before the invoice is raised.

| Status standing on the programme | What the period is invoiced |
| --- | --- |
| active | the monthly programme fee printed against the tier, plus the per-head charge |
| paused | the standby charge printed against the tier, and no per-head charge |
| proposed | no programme fee is invoiced |
| closed | no programme fee is invoiced |

## What the programme fee already covers, and what it does not

Barista hours included in the tier are covered by the programme fee, and hours beyond them are billed at the barista rate printed against the tier, counted in whole hours and rounded up; a part hour beyond the included allocation therefore counts as a whole hour. Paper goods and equipment servicing at the visit count printed against the tier are inside the programme fee and are never charged separately.

## Escalation and price notice

The annual escalation printed against the tier is applied on the first invoice raised on or after each anniversary of the agreement start date, and never mid-year: an invoice raised on the anniversary day itself is the first invoice on or after it and carries the escalation, while an invoice raised the day before that anniversary does not. Product price increases are notified the number of days in advance printed against the tier, and an increase applied without that notice is credited back on the next invoice.
